verdict.rationale: gstack's source is publicly readable in the garrytan/gstack GitHub repo. The pack cites raw files throughout (SKILL.md files, ARCHITECTURE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md), and dev mode runs skills straight from a repo checkout. Community posts confirm a git-clone install and that a user repackaged and republished the agent. However, nothing in the pack states what license the code is under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), independent confirmation of the license terms.
